fieldValues.title: Sources your AI can read
fieldValues.summary: Drag text files (notes, transcripts, a report, up to 1 MB each) or a link into your essay. Drop on a paragraph to link the source to it, or anywhere on the page to keep it in References. Put the documents your essay answers, such as a funding call, under Context documents. Every connected AI reads your sources, so it can check your claims against them.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: read each source through its attachment before commenting; point the writer to References with ui_highlight.
